notes: Atomic edit conformance cases for data/contracts/atomic_edit.yaml. Pinned receipts were computed from the contract-derived reference engine in tests/test_t0203_atomic_edit_contract.py. Every malformed row names a single-locus minimal repair (request or base) that makes the edit commit. Rollback rows pair a rejected edit with a valid follow-up on the same base object.

happy.name: put_inserts_into_nonempty_base
happy.why: a put of an absent identity inserts it

happy.name: put_replaces_present_identity
happy.why: a put of a present identity replaces it (upsert); the derived record is identical so the target equals the base

happy.name: delete_removes_present_identity
happy.why: a delete of a present identity removes it

happy.name: mixed_multi_operation_edit
happy.why: put, delete and upsert in one edit commit together

boundary.name: empty_base_put
boundary.why: the empty state accepts a first put

boundary.name: empty_operations_noop
boundary.why: an edit with no operations commits the base unchanged

boundary.name: delete_last_identity_to_empty
boundary.why: deleting the only identity reaches the empty state

boundary.name: empty_base_empty_operations
boundary.why: the empty state with no operations

boundary.name: operation_order_reversed
boundary.why: the mixed edit in reverse order gives the same receipt

malformed.name: request_not_a_dict
malformed.defect: the request is a list, not a dict

malformed.name: request_missing_operations
malformed.defect: the request has no operations field

malformed.name: request_renamed_field
malformed.defect: the request renames operations to operation at the same arity

malformed.name: request_extra_field
malformed.defect: the request carries an unknown extra field

malformed.name: base_id_bad_grammar
malformed.defect: base_id breaks the gs1 grammar

malformed.name: base_id_trailing_newline
malformed.defect: base_id ends in a newline, which the grammar's $ accepts but a full match rejects

malformed.name: base_id_not_a_string
malformed.defect: base_id is an int

malformed.name: operations_not_a_list
malformed.defect: operations is a dict, not a list

malformed.name: operations_empty_non_list
malformed.defect: operations is an empty string, not a list

malformed.name: operation_extra_field
malformed.defect: an operation carries an extra field

malformed.name: operation_renamed_field
malformed.defect: an operation renames record to payload at the same arity

malformed.name: operation_unknown_kind
malformed.defect: an operation kind is upsert, not put or delete

malformed.name: delete_with_record
malformed.defect: a delete carries a record instead of null

malformed.name: put_null_record
malformed.defect: a put carries a null record

malformed.name: put_identity_mismatch
malformed.defect: a put record derives a different identity than the operation names

malformed.name: put_wrong_digest
malformed.defect: a put record has a well-formed but wrong digest

malformed.name: put_non_canonical_fen
malformed.defect: a put record carries a parseable but non-canonical snapshot_fen (clocks 5 9)

malformed.name: put_record_missing_field
malformed.defect: a put record has no digest field

malformed.name: duplicate_identity
malformed.defect: two operations target the same identity

malformed.name: base_not_a_dict
malformed.defect: the base is a list of records, not a map

malformed.name: base_key_mismatch
malformed.defect: a base key is not its record's identity

malformed.name: base_record_wrong_digest
malformed.defect: a base record has a well-formed but wrong digest

malformed.name: base_id_names_another_state
malformed.defect: base_id is the id of a different valid state

malformed.name: base_differs_from_base_id
malformed.defect: the base is missing a record the base_id covers

malformed.name: delete_absent_identity
malformed.defect: a delete targets an identity absent from the base

rollback.name: last_operation_unknown_identity
rollback.why: valid puts then a delete of an absent identity: nothing commits

rollback.name: middle_operation_malformed
rollback.why: a malformed record between valid operations: nothing commits

rollback.name: stale_base_id
rollback.why: an edit labelled with the pre-edit state id of a different base: nothing commits
